source_provenance.tidytuesday_intro_note: The fightr package compiles datasets from UFC athlete profiles, UFCStats, Kaggle Ultimate UFC Dataset, and Octagon API.
source_provenance.license_note: No dataset-specific license was established during this acquisition pass. Preserve source provenance and use this snapshot for private research/modeling unless upstream terms are clarified further.

semantics.historical_feature_rule: For a target fight, only ranking observations with ranking_date strictly before the target information cutoff may be used. Never take the nearest future ranking.
semantics.identity_warning: Fighter is name text, not a stable source fighter ID. Match into canonical UFC Edge identity separately and fail closed on ambiguity.
